scope: Only fifteen generated public indexes/compact parts from officially terminal runs12–18. Exact original complete public objects remain in fixed Git and are mapped individually below. Current independent mathematical/terminal notes, controllers, workflows, requests, all complete parameter queues and scientific source packages stay unchanged.
public_object_canonicalization: For locator fingerprints only: UTF-8 JSON, object keys sorted recursively, array order and every JSON value preserved; no calculation with scientific values. Original exact file bytes remain authoritative.

full_data_restoration.all_original_public_fields: Each indexed original JSON fence is complete at its exact fixed file/blob/byte/SHA record. Restore that whole file before reading any original input/output scalar, command, error, actual resource or cleanup metadata. Nothing is substituted from another run. The small ledger is not a replacement report.
full_data_restoration.current_duplicates: Where complete_current_exact_duplicate_locations is nonempty, that entire parsed JSON object was found equal in the indicated unchanged current note. Other full objects are recovered from fixed Git; no claim that an incomplete note is a whole duplicate.
full_data_restoration.requests: Each entire original index request object was compared to its retained complete request JSON; all seven are equal. Complete source/target/history fields remain in those requests.
full_data_restoration.parameters: Every current queue was fully read below100000 bytes and is recorded whole. All argv, outputs, summary/progress selectors, parent paths, cleanup and scope fields remain in the unchanged complete object. The actual prior queue path_commit/SHA in each returned stage is also kept. Current queue need not equal an earlier queue; retrieve prior queue at its own recorded commit.
full_data_restoration.raw_runner_boundary: Public indexes/parts are metadata and scalar observations. Complete raw arrays, full reports and full logs were runner-only. Git retention cannot make unavailable runner files restartable, and they are not claimed restored.
full_data_restoration.exact_old_bytes: Use git show FIXED_OUTPUT_SNAPSHOT:PATH, or git cat-file blob BLOB from the historical object store. Never substitute JSON reformatting for an original whole-file hash.
full_data_restoration.future_regeneration: The retained controller/producer plus complete original requests/queues define how these metadata outputs are generated from actual runner returns. A new run does not recreate original timestamps, elapsed resources, GitHub status or accepted points; exact historical output requires the fixed whole Git bytes.
full_data_restoration.unreturned_science: All seven terminal runs still have their last scientific child unobserved as naturally returning. Official cancelled is not a child exit code, success, complete final, empty typed history or no-solution proof.

producer_read_write_contract.writer: Publisher.render takes actual status.completed, its explicit selected compact fields, cleanup-metadata projection, optional bounded active_progress_observation and original request; it emits bounded index/part Markdown. Publisher.publish writes those files and the same-run HANDOFF slot.
producer_read_write_contract.followup_record_reader_writer: _Followups.begin reads actual whole queue, creates detached source worktree and hashes exact script/optional parent. run_step polls natural exit, hashes actual existing outputs, reads explicit report scalars, keeps missing_outputs/summary_errors and actual duration/exit. finish_record persists original journal/status before Publisher.render.
producer_read_write_contract.consumer_scope: This was a complete text inspection of the controllers/render and followup begin/run_step/finish_record/_summary, not proof of no possible other reader. Historical documentation links and any other consumer restore the exact complete old file first. Do not edit scientific guards, protocols or values to accept a projection.

actual_critical_limits_retained.source_worktree: detached; ordinary publication pulls do not replace live scientific modules
actual_critical_limits_retained.original_status_and_journal_recoverabili: not inferred from public compact files

execution_versions_and_resources.original_per_stage_seconds_exit_and_all_: kept in per-stage records and exact original complete JSON fences

publication: Root alone performs fresh exact path/blob/size matches and ordinary deletions. If a file changed, leave it and its actual record untouched. This package adds no scientific admission or re-execution gate.
